Runs open-source and official models by API: images, video, audio and language.

## API key

1. Open [replicate.com](https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API token from Replicate's API tokens page.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add replicate
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  replicate: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Replicate's [API](https://replicate.com/docs/reference/http) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show replicate` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 600 a minute. Creating predictions 600 a minute; every other endpoint 3,000 a minute.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Replicate).
